question: Whether exact current-AWQ one-layer MTP can load in pinned vLLM 0.15.0 and plausibly clear a 10% c16 cost reduction.

source_support.planner: SpeculativeConfig.hf_config_override rewrites Glm4MoeLiteForCausalLM to glm4_moe_lite_mtp with num_hidden_layers=0 and n_predict=1
source_support.loader: Glm4MoeLiteMTP rewrites model.layers.47 payload names and explicitly shares embed_tokens only

pinned_runtime.stage: ModelConfig exact checkpoint config parse, before model allocation or tensor loading
pinned_runtime.observed_error: ValueError: checkpoint model type glm4_moe_lite is not recognized by installed Transformers
pinned_runtime.interpretation: The included vLLM MTP source is unreachable for this exact checkpoint in the declared pinned image; stock serving cannot establish an MTP configuration without changing the runtime image or model-class/config path, both outside scope.

c16_economics_bound.one_layer_mtp_model: With one MTP layer, each round can add at most one accepted draft token. If draft overhead is h times one baseline target decode round and A is accepted draft tokens per round, speed multiplier=(1+A)/(1+h). A 10% speed/cost gain requires A >= 0.10 + 1.10*h.
c16_economics_bound.later_matched_experiment_if_runtime_is_r: One retained L40S c16 off/on session: exact current AWQ, same 8192/1024 workload and disabled prefix cache, MTP method with num_speculative_tokens=1. Record proposal and accepted tokens/round, draft/verify and endpoint wall time, fallback/errors, exact output identity, and VRAM/KV; require >=588.815 output tok/s plus identity before a cost claim.

decision: Close current-AWQ MTP in the pinned-runtime scope. Do not nominate a provider arm.
